newsitem.title: USA: Pratt to buy Howmet airfoil overhaul unit.
newsitem.headline: Pratt to buy Howmet airfoil overhaul unit.

text.p: Pratt & Whitney, a unit of United Technologies Corp., on Wednesday said it agreed to purchase Howmet Corp's airfoil refurbishment business.
Pratt will buy Howmet plants in Wichita Falls, Texas; Claremore, Oklahoma, and North Haven, Connecticut.
Pratt said it expected the acquisition to be completed in about two months.
Howmet Corp, the world's biggest maker of investment cast components for gas turbine engines, is owned by a joint venture of the Carlyle Group and Thiokol Corp.

Howmet's refurbishment business will be added to Pratt's Eagle Services business, which encompasses all of its overhaul and repair operations in the United States, Ireland, the Netherlands, Taiwan and Singapore.
